0.original: Esmour needs an exterminator at the Church of Saint Adama Landama.

1.original: Corpses have drawn blowfly swarms to the vicinity of the church. Slay five of the swarms to keep them in check.

2.original: You have slain five blowfly swarms. Report back to Esmour at the church.

3.original: Esmour thanks you for having ensured the safety and well-being of the mourners who visit the church.

48.original: You have troubled yourself to come all this way. I wonder if I might not trouble you a bit further.

49.original: As you well know, we keep a lichyard here. The scent of death's decay draws blowfly swarms, which are as unclean as they are unwelcome.

50.original: Slay five of these pestilent swarms, and the church will be in your debt.

51.original: Thank you, friend. If the swarms were to spread their pestilence at the church unchecked, before long we would need to mourn the mourning.

52.original: For the time being, at least, the grieving can pray in peace for their dead to cross over safely. Thal bless you.
